Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to disambiguate between multiple valid candidates provided by the WebSurfer. The search results explicitly identified two historians translated by Bousquet: Al-Ghazali (Persian) and Ibn Khaldun (Tunisian/North African Arab). The Planner incorrectly selected Al-Ghazali as the sole answer and misidentified him as a "historian" (he is primarily a theologian/philosopher), while ignoring the Tunisian historian Ibn Khaldun who fits the "North African Arab" heritage description in the ground truth. This represents a failure to synthesize all available data and a premature conclusion based on incomplete analysis.
